name: canvhq-root
description: CanvHQ - a self-hostable, end-to-end encrypted whiteboard

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C backend typecheck && pnpm -C frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm -C backend lint && pnpm -C frontend lint
scripts.format: pnpm -C backend format && pnpm -C frontend format
scripts.format:check: pnpm -C backend format:check && pnpm -C frontend format:check
scripts.test: pnpm -C backend test && pnpm -C frontend test -- --run
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm -C backend test:cov && pnpm -C frontend test:coverage
scripts.build: pnpm -C frontend run build && pnpm -C backend run build
